blocks.text: Simple distillation solution se solvent alag karne ke liye hai. Misal ke taur par 100 cm³ samandar ka pani lein aur apparatus (distilling flask, condenser aur receiving flask) lagayen. Flask mein boiling chips ke chand tukre dalein taake liquid jhatke se uchhle nahi (bumping na ho). Poora apparatus air tight (hawa-band) karein taake vapours (bhaap) bahar na niklein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai 'Set up the apparatus as shown in the Figure 15.5'. Lekin Figure 15.5 crystallization ki tasveer hai, distillation ki nahi. Kitab mein simple distillation ke apparatus ki alag tasveer nahi; Figure 15.7 fractional distillation ka set-up hai, jis mein se fractionating column hata dein to simple distillation ka apparatus ban jata hai.

Flask ko Bunsen burner se halka garam karein. Tap khol dein taake condenser ke gird thanda pani aahista ghoomta rahe. Jab boiling point aata hai to pani (ya alcohol) bhaap banta hai aur us ke vapours condenser se guzarte hain. Condenser ke gird ghoomta pani in vapours ko thanda kar ke wapas liquid bana deta hai (condense karta hai). Is liquid ko distillate kehte hain aur yeh receiving flask mein jama hota hai. Distillation flask mein jo cheezen bach jati hain unhen mil kar residue kehte hain.

Do miscible liquids ko is tarah alag karna fractional distillation kehlata hai. Fractional distillation tabhi kamyab hoti hai jab dono liquids ke boiling points mein taqreeban 25°C ka farq ho. Distillation column sheeshe ka aala (equipment) hai jo liquids ke mixture ko un ke boiling points ke mutabiq alag alag hisson mein baant deta hai. Column mein glass beads (sheeshe ke moti) bhare hote hain taake vapours ke condense hone ke liye zyada surface area (satah) mile, Figure 15.7.

blocks.alt: Thermometer reading aur waqt (time) ka graph: curve oopar jati hai, 78 degrees C par seedhi rehti hai (ethanol distil hota hai), phir oopar ja kar 100 degrees C par seedhi ho jati hai (pani distil hota hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 15.6: Ethanol / pani ke mixture ki fractional distillation (kitab ki Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ki do seedhi (flat) jagahen boiling points hain. Jab tak ethanol distil ho raha hai, thermometer 78°C par ruka rehta hai; ethanol khatam hone par temperature barhta hai aur 100°C par pani distil hota hai. Isi waqt receiving flask badla jata hai.

blocks.alt: Fractional distillation ka apparatus: shole par distilling flask, us ke oopar fractionating column aur thermometer, phir condenser jis mein thanda pani neeche wale sire se dakhil hota aur oopar wale sire se nikalta hai, aur conical flask mein distillate.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.7: Fractional distillation ka setup (kitab ki Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein 'Cold water in' condenser ke oopar wale sire (flask ki taraf) par aur 'Water out' neeche wale sire par dikhaya gaya hai. Yeh ulta hai: thanda pani hamesha condenser ke neeche wale sire se andar aata hai aur oopar wale sire se nikalta hai, taake jacket poori pani se bhari rahe aur vapours achhi tarah thande hon. Hum ne sahi rukh banaya hai.

Misal ke taur par jab ethyl alcohol aur pani ka mixture garam kiya jaye to pehle ethyl alcohol distil ho kar nikalta hai, kyun ke us ka boiling point 78 °C hai jo pani ke boiling point 100 °C se kam hai. Jab tak alcohol distil ho raha hai, thermometer 78 °C par hi rehta hai. Jaise hi temperature 78 °C se oopar jane lage, receiving flask hata kar naya flask laga dein, Figure 15.7.

Dobara garam karein. Jab thermometer 100 °C tak pohnchta hai to pani ubalne lagta hai, aur condense ho kar receiving flask mein doosre distillate ke taur par jama hota hai. Is tarah dono components khalis (pure) shakal mein mil jate hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Qudrati (natural) petroleum bohat se compounds ka mixture hai jo aam taur par fuel (indhan) ke taur par istemal hote hain, jaise petrol, diesel, mitti ka tel (kerosene oil) aur furnace oil. In ke boiling points ek doosre se bohat mukhtalif nahi. Inhen fractionating ya distillation column mein fractional distillation se alag alag hisson (fractions) ki shakal mein alag kiya jata hai.

blocks.caption: Simple aur fractional distillation
rows: wahi, saath glass beads wala fractionating column

blocks.prompt: a) Simple distillation aur fractional distillation mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Simple distillation solvent ko us mein hal shuda solid se alag karti hai (solvent ubal kar condense hota hai, solid residue mein rehta hai). Fractional distillation do miscible liquids ko alag karti hai jin ke boiling points mein taqreeban 25°C farq ho; is mein glass beads wala fractionating column lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Fractional distillation ke rozmarra zindagi mein kuch istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: Petroleum ko petrol, diesel, kerosene oil aur furnace oil mein alag karna; pani aur alcohol ke mixture se alcohol nikalna.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke sawal (b) mein 'fractional filtration' chhapa hai; aisa koi process nahi. Sahi lafz 'fractional distillation' hai.

blocks.prompt: Fractionating column ka kya kaam hai, aur dono liquids ke boiling points mein taqreeban 25°C farq kyun hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Glass beads bara surface area dete hain jis par uthte vapours bar bar condense ho kar dobara bhaap bante hain; har baar vapour mein kam boiling point wala liquid zyada ho jata hai, is liye oopar sirf woh pohnchta hai. Agar boiling points bohat qareeb hon to vapour mein dono liquids hote hain aur distillate mixture hi rehta hai.

items: Simple distillation: boiling chips, air tight apparatus, halki garmi, thande pani wala condenser; distillate jama hota hai, residue flask mein rehta hai.
Fractional distillation: glass beads wala column; ethanol 78 °C par (thermometer rukta hai), temperature barhe to receiver badlein, pani 100 °C par; petroleum fractions.
